name: OAHHazardType
title: OneAquaHealth Aquatic Environmental Hazard Types
publisher: OneAquaHealth Consortium - Semantic Interoperability Working Group
description: Taxonomy of aquatic environmental health hazards identified across urban aquatic ecosystems.

concept.definition: Proliferation surge or visual bloom of potential microcystin-producing cyanobacteria in urban freshwater.
Ecological surge in disease-transmitting diptera (Culicidae/Chironomidae) breeding in urban aquatic buffer zones.
Microbial enteropathogenic contamination spike following combined sewer runoff or severe storm surge.
Point-source or surface-runoff acute chemical or heavy metal influx into urban river reaches.
